adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the response now includes `meta: { total: ... }` rather than a `user_count` field (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb). The JS `Discourse.Group#findMembers` explicitly remaps `result.meta.total` into the model’s `user_count` (`self.setProperties({ user_count: result.meta.total, ... })`), so it won’t break this client, but it does introduce an API naming inconsistency versus the `user_count` used elsewhere (e.g., group serializer) that other consumers would need to translate.
